bookSourceComment: 成人 AI 短剧站，仅限成年人使用。v3.1.0 配置项版：书源登录界面提供「线路」配置项（Legado loginUi 兼容）——填写发布页 hgai12.com 上任一线路域名可固定线路；留空则自动发现（入口经发布页，线路故障自动切换，正常翻页仅 1 请求）。登录入口即发布页，可随时查看全部可用线路。播放走当期线路 /api/videos/{id}/play?ep={N}（全链路跟随活线路，书架旧线路记录自动迁移）。作者=详情「出品」（列表层逐部拉取，「作者」填0可关）（如黄果官方/吴明等，缺失时兜底题材标签），最新章节取 data-ep-base；封面为服务端 AES 加密，书源内置纯 JS 解密器还原真实封面（配置「封面」填 0 可关回占位图）；解密较慢，列表封面会逐张出现。依赖 omnireadMediaType 短剧扩展。

ruleSearch.bookList: @js:(function(){var nav=/[?&]nav=([a-z-]+)/.exec(baseUrl);var q=/[?&]q=([^&]*)/.exec(baseUrl);var pg=/[?&]pg=(\d+)/.exec(baseUrl);var pgn=pg?parseInt(pg[1],10):(page||1);var path='';if(nav)path='/'+nav[1]+'/'+pgn+'/';else if(q)path='/search/video/'+q[1]+'/'+pgn+'/';else if(key&&String(key).length)path='/search/video/'+encodeURIComponent(String(key))+'/'+pgn+'/';else path='/ai-duanju/'+pgn+'/';var html=hgFetch(path);if(!html)return [];var t=/data-pages="(\d+)"/.exec(html);if(t&&pgn>parseInt(t[1],10))return [];var g=/<div\s+class="[^"]*\bhg-card-grid\b[^"]*"[^>]*>/.exec(html);if(!g)return [];var seg=html.slice(g.index+g[0].length);var nx=/<div\s+class="[^"]*\bhg-card-grid\b/.exec(seg);if(nx)seg=seg.slice(0,nx.index);return seg.match(/<div\s+class="hg-drama-card"[\s\S]*?(?=<div\s+class="hg-drama-card"|<div\s+class="[^"]*hg-card-grid|$)/g)||[];})()

ruleSearch.author: @js:(function(){try{var cfg=source.getLoginInfoMap?source.getLoginInfoMap():{};if(String((cfg||{})['作者']||'')==='0')return '';var m=/href="(\/video\/\d+\/)"/.exec(result);if(!m)return '';var vid=m[1];var c='';try{c=String(java.get('au_'+vid)||'');}catch(e){}if(c)return c;var hosts=[];try{var cc=java.get('hgHost');if(cc)hosts.push(cc);}catch(e){}if(!hosts.length){var hs=hgHosts();for(var i=0;i<hs.length&&i<4;i++)hosts.push(hs[i]);}for(var j=0;j<hosts.length;j++){try{var html=String(java.ajax('https://'+hosts[j]+vid));var mm=/\/author\/\d+\/">([^<]+)<\/a>/.exec(html);if(mm&&mm[1].trim()){c=mm[1].trim();try{java.put('au_'+vid,c);java.put('hgHost',hosts[j]);}catch(e){}return c;}}catch(e){}}return '';}catch(e){return ''}})()

ruleContent.content: @js:(function(){var m=/\/video\/(\d+)\/(?:ep-(\d+)\/?)?/.exec(baseUrl);if(!m)return '';var org=(baseUrl||'').replace(/^(https?:\/\/[^\/]+).*$/,'$1');var H={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36','Referer':org+'/'};try{var r=java.ajax(org+'/api/videos/'+m[1]+'/play?ep='+(m[2]||'1'));var d=JSON.parse(r);var u=d&&d.data&&d.data.video_url||'';if(u)return JSON.stringify({url:u,headers:H});}catch(e){}return ''})()
